---
title: "Unrestricted overall survival — Adjusted (hierarchical) fitting"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

Five Bayesian proportional-hazards models adjust for binary ECOG, stage,
categorical mGPS, and `(1 || diagnosis)`. The diagnosis intercepts share an
estimated variance, providing partial pooling across the source SNOMED
diagnosis groups. The five-df M-spline baseline and fixed-effect priors match
Adjusted (fixed); the diagnosis variance uses `decov()`.

This sensitivity analysis assesses robustness to the diagnosis adjustment
structure. It does not assume that hierarchical adjustment must improve
balance or remove bias. Its treatment hazard ratio is conditional on the
measured covariates and diagnosis effects.

```{r}
#| label: fit-os-hierarchical
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
artifact_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "supporting", "os-unrestricted-hierarchical")
datasets <- readRDS(file.path(artifact_dir, "completed-datasets.rds"))
stopifnot(length(datasets) == 5L)
for (index in 1:5) {
  fitting_data <- datasets[[index]] |> filter(survival_time_days_unrestricted > 0)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(fitting_data), nrow(fitting_data) > 0L)
  model_path <- file.path(artifact_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  input_hash <- digest::digest(list(fitting_data, "os-hierarchical-ph-v1"))
  model <- if (file.exists(model_path)) readRDS(model_path) else NULL
  if (identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1") || is.null(model) ||
      !identical(attr(model, "input_hash"), input_hash)) {
    model <- rstanarm::stan_surv(
      survival::Surv(survival_time_days_unrestricted, status_death_unrestricted) ~
        tx + ecog_binary + stage_binary + mgps + (1 || diagnosis),
      data = fitting_data, basehaz = "ms", basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
      prior = rstanarm::normal(location = rep(0, 5), scale = c(0.55, rep(2.5, 4))),
      prior_intercept = rstanarm::normal(0, 20), prior_aux = rstanarm::dirichlet(1),
      prior_covariance = rstanarm::decov(),
      chains = 4L, cores = 4L, iter = 2000L, warmup = 1000L,
      adapt_delta = 0.99, refresh = 0L, seed = 4200L + index)
    attr(model, "input_hash") <- input_hash
    saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  }
}
```
